# ISteth
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/lido/ISteth.sol)

**Title:**
ISteth

Minimal interface for Lido's stETH token


## Functions
### submit

Send funds to the pool with optional _referral parameter

This function is alternative way to submit funds. Supports optional referral address.


```solidity
function submit(address _referral) external payable returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_referral`|`address`|Optional referral address for tracking|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Amount of StETH shares generated|

### approve

**Parameters**

|----|----|-----------|
|`_spender`|`address`|The address allowed to spend|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|The amount approved|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the approval succeeded|
